quranTranslation.text: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination.

explanation.bs: „Mi smo ga spustili u Noći kadr“ – tefsir se razilazi: spuštanje cijelog Kur'ana na najbliže nebo, ili početak objave.
explanation.en: “We revealed it on the Night of Predestination” — tafsir differs: the whole Quran sent down to the nearest heaven, or the beginning of its revelation.

quranTranslation.text: We verily sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and revealed with them the Scripture and the Balance, that mankind may observe right measure; and He revealed iron, wherein is mighty power and (many) uses for mankind, and that Allah may know him who helpeth Him and His messengers, though unseen. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty.

explanation.bs: „I spustili smo željezo“ – أَنْزَلَ i za ono što nije objava.
explanation.en: “And He revealed [i.e. sent down] iron” — أَنْزَلَ also for what is not revelation.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Believe in Allah and His messenger and the Scripture which He hath revealed unto His messenger, and the Scripture which He revealed aforetime. Whoso disbelieveth in Allah and His angels and His scriptures and His messengers and the Last Day, he verily hath wandered far astray.

explanation.bs: Knjiga koju je objavio (نَزَّلَ) Svome Poslaniku i Knjiga koju je objavio (أَنْزَلَ) prije – oba oblika u jednom ajetu.
explanation.en: The Book He sent down (نَزَّلَ) upon His Messenger and the Book He sent down (أَنْزَلَ) before — both forms in one ayah.

quranTranslation.text: He hath revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture with truth, confirming that which was (revealed) before it, even as He revealed the Torah and the Gospel.

explanation.bs: Kur'anu stoji نَزَّلَ, a Tevratu i Indžilu أَنْزَلَ – dva oblika u istom ajetu.
explanation.en: For the Quran نَزَّلَ, for the Torah and the Gospel أَنْزَلَ — the two forms in one ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And (it is) a Qur'an that We have divided, that thou mayst recite it unto mankind at intervals, and We have revealed it by (successive) revelation.

explanation.bs: Kur'an smo podijelili da ga ljudima polahko čitaš, i postepeno smo ga objavljivali – نَزَّلْنَاهُ تَنزِيلًا.
explanation.en: A Quran We have divided, that you might recite it to the people over time, and We sent it down in stages — نَزَّلْنَاهُ تَنزِيلًا.

quranTranslation.text: And those who disbelieve say: Why is the Qur'an not revealed unto him all at once? (It is revealed) thus that We may strengthen thy heart therewith; and We have arranged it in right order.

explanation.bs: Nevjernici pitaju zašto mu Kur'an nije objavljen (نُزِّلَ) „odjednom” – drugi oblik čak i uz „odjednom”: razlika je sklonost, ne pravilo.
explanation.en: The unbelievers ask why the Quran was not sent down (نُزِّلَ) “all at once” — Form II even with “all at once”: the difference is a tendency, not a rule.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah commandeth you that ye restore deposits to their owners, and, if ye judge between mankind, that ye judge justly. Lo! comely is this which Allah admonisheth you. Lo! Allah is ever Hearer, Seer.

explanation.bs: „…a kad sudite među ljudima, da sudite pravedno“ – suđenje među ljudima.
explanation.en: “…if ye judge between mankind, that ye judge justly” — judging between people.

quranTranslation.text: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment concerning the field, when people's sheep had strayed and browsed therein by night; and We were witnesses to their judgment.

explanation.bs: Davud i Sulejman, „kad su presuđivali o usjevu“ – presuda u sporu.
explanation.en: David and Solomon, “when they gave judgment concerning the field” — a verdict in a dispute.

quranTranslation.text: And the Jews say the Christians follow nothing (true), and the Christians say the Jews follow nothing (true); yet both are readers of the Scripture. Even thus speak those who know not. Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they differ.

explanation.bs: „Na Sudnjem danu Allah će među njima suditi o onome oko čega su se razišli.“
explanation.en: “Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they differ.”

quranTranslation.text: Thy Lord hath decreed, that ye worship none save Him, and (that ye show) kindness to parents. If one of them or both of them attain old age with thee, say not "Fie" unto them nor repulse them, but speak unto them a gracious word.

explanation.bs: „Tvoj Gospodar je naredio da ne obožavate nikoga osim Njega“ – قَضَى kao Allahova naredba.
explanation.en: “Thy Lord hath decreed, that ye worship none save Him” — قَضَى as Allah's command.

gloss.en: to decree; to settle, to complete

quranTranslation.text: Then He ordained them seven heavens in two Days and inspired in each heaven its mandate; and We decked the nether heaven with lamps, and rendered it inviolable. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Knower.

explanation.bs: „I dovršio ih je (فَقَضَاهُنَّ) u dva dana kao sedam nebesa“ – ar-Rāġib: stvaranje i njegovo dovršenje.
explanation.en: “Then He ordained [completed] them (فَقَضَاهُنَّ) seven heavens in two Days” — ar-Rāġib: creating, and finishing it.

gloss.en: to decree; to settle, to complete

quranTranslation.text: And when ye have completed your devotions, then remember Allah as ye remember your fathers or with a more lively remembrance. But of mankind is he who saith: "Our Lord! Give unto us in the world," and he hath no portion in the Hereafter.

explanation.bs: „A kad obavite svoje obrede…“ – ljudsko obavljanje i završavanje.
explanation.en: “And when ye have completed your devotions…” — people carrying a thing out to its end.

gloss.en: to decree; to settle, to complete

quranTranslation.text: Throw that which is in thy right hand! It will eat up that which they have made. Lo! that which they have made is but a wizard's artifice, and a wizard shall not be successful to whatever point (of skill) he may attain.

explanation.bs: „A čarobnjak neće uspjeti gdje god došao“ – sihr bez stvarne moći.
explanation.en: “A wizard shall not be successful to whatever point (of skill) he may attain” — sorcery without real power.

quranTranslation.text: Is it a wonder for mankind that We have inspired a man among them, saying: Warn mankind and bring unto those who believe the good tidings that they have a sure footing with their Lord? The disbelievers say: Lo! this is a mere wizard.

explanation.bs: Nevjernici o Poslaniku: „Ovo je doista očiti čarobnjak!“ – optužba koju Kur'an odbacuje.
explanation.en: The disbelievers of the Prophet: “Lo! this is a mere wizard” — a charge the Quran rejects.

quranTranslation.text: And they said: O wizard! Entreat thy Lord for us by the pact that He hath made with thee. Lo! we verily will walk aright.

explanation.bs: Faraonovi ljudi Musau: „O čarobnjače, zamoli za nas svoga Gospodara“ – ar-Rāġib: tako su ga zvali u smislu opsjene i vještine ruku.
explanation.en: Pharaoh's people to Moses: “O wizard! Entreat thy Lord for us” — ar-Rāġib: they called him so in the sense of illusion and sleight of hand.

quranTranslation.text: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.

explanation.bs: „Ti, blagodaću svoga Gospodara, nisi ni vrač ni luđak.“
explanation.en: “By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.”

quranTranslation.text: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember!

explanation.bs: „Niti je to govor vrača – kako se malo opominjete!“
explanation.en: “Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember!”

quranTranslation.text: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe!

explanation.bs: „I nije to govor pjesnika – kako malo vjerujete!“
explanation.en: “It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe!”

quranTranslation.text: Nay, say they, (these are but) muddled dreams; nay, he hath but invented it; nay, he is but a poet. Let him bring us a portent even as those of old (who were Allah's messengers) were sent (with portents).

explanation.bs: „…ne, nego ga je izmislio, ne, nego je on pjesnik“ – optužbe se nižu jedna za drugom.
explanation.en: “…nay, he hath but invented it; nay, he is but a poet” — the charges follow one another.

quranTranslation.text: As for poets, the erring follow them.

explanation.bs: „A pjesnike slijede oni koji su zalutali“ – ar-Rāġib: odatle veza poezije i izmišljanja.
explanation.en: “As for poets, the erring follow them” — ar-Rāġib: hence poetry's link to invention.

quranTranslation.text: But when they spy some merchandise or pastime they break away to it and leave thee standing. Say: That which Allah hath is better than pastime and than merchandise, and Allah is the Best of providers.

explanation.bs: „A kad ugledaju trgovinu ili zabavu, razbježe se prema njoj… Reci: Ono što je kod Allaha bolje je od zabave i od trgovine.“
explanation.en: “But when they spy some merchandise or pastime they break away to it … Say: That which Allah hath is better than pastime and than merchandise.”

quranTranslation.text: This life of the world is but a pastime and a game. Lo! the home of the Hereafter - that is Life, if they but knew.

explanation.bs: „Ovaj dunjalučki život samo je zabava i igra, a ahiretski dom je, zaista, pravi život.“
explanation.en: “This life of the world is but a pastime and a game. Lo! the home of the Hereafter - that is Life.”

quranTranslation.text: Naught is the life of the world save a pastime and a sport. Better far is the abode of the Hereafter for those who keep their duty (to Allah). Have ye then no sense?

explanation.bs: „Dunjalučki život samo je igra i zabava, a ahiretski dom bolji je za one koji se Allaha boje.“
explanation.en: “Naught is the life of the world save a pastime and a sport. Better far is the abode of the Hereafter for those who keep their duty (to Allah).”

quranTranslation.text: And when ye call to prayer they take it for a jest and sport. That is because they are a folk who understand not.

explanation.bs: „A kad pozivate na namaz, oni ga uzimaju za ruganje i igru“ – igra uz ruganje.
explanation.en: “And when ye call to prayer they take it for a jest and sport” — play joined with mockery.

quranTranslation.text: And forsake those who take their religion for a pastime and a jest, and whom the life of the world beguileth. Remind (mankind) hereby lest a soul be destroyed by what it earneth. It hath beside Allah no protecting ally nor intercessor, and though it offer every compensation it will not be accepted from it. Those are they who perish by their own deserts. For them is drink of boiling water and a painful doom, because they disbelieved.

explanation.bs: „I ostavi one koji svoju vjeru uzimaju kao igru i zabavu.“
explanation.en: “And forsake those who take their religion for a pastime and a jest.”

quranTranslation.text: (And it was said unto his son): O John! Hold fast the Scripture. And we gave him wisdom when a child,

explanation.bs: „O Jahja, uzmi Knjigu svom snagom!“ – ar-Rāġib: snagom srca.
explanation.en: “O John! Hold fast [literally: take with strength] the Scripture” — ar-Rāġib: with strength of heart.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might.

explanation.bs: „Allah je, zaista, Onaj Koji daje opskrbu, Vlasnik snage, Čvrsti“ – Allahova moć, kako Njemu priliči; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might” — Allah's power, as befits Him; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: So fight (O Muhammad) in the way of Allah Thou art not taxed (with the responsibility for anyone) except thyself - and urge on the believers. Peradventure Allah will restrain the might of those who disbelieve. Allah is stronger in might and stronger in inflicting punishment.

explanation.bs: „… a Allah je veće žestine i strožije kazne“ – kako Njemu priliči; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “… Allah is stronger in might and stronger in inflicting punishment” — as befits Him; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: They will not fight against you in a body save in fortified villages or from behind walls. Their adversity among themselves is very great. Ye think of them as a whole whereas their hearts are divers. That is because they are a folk who have no sense.

explanation.bs: „Žestina koju imaju jedni prema drugima ljuta je“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Their adversity among themselves is very great” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish.

explanation.bs: „Na Dan kad ćemo zahvatiti najvećim zahvatom – Mi ćemo se, zaista, osvetiti“ – kako Njemu priliči; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish” — as befits Him; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.

explanation.bs: „Zahvat Gospodara tvoga je, zaista, žestok“ – kako Njemu priliči; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Lo! the punishment [baṭš: the seizing] of thy Lord is stern” — as befits Him; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Then We destroyed men mightier than these in prowess; and the example of the men of old hath gone (before them).

explanation.bs: „Pa smo uništili one koji su od njih bili jači u zahvatu …“
explanation.en: “Then We destroyed men mightier than these in prowess …”

quranTranslation.text: Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah),

explanation.bs: „Nuhov narod utjerao je u laž poslanike“ – utjerani u laž su oni koji su govorili istinu.
explanation.en: “Noah's folk denied the messengers” — those called liars were the ones who spoke the truth.

gloss.en: to belie, to call a lie

quranTranslation.text: We know well how their talk grieveth thee, though in truth they deny not thee (Muhammad) but evil-doers flout the revelations of Allah.

explanation.bs: „… oni tebe ne utjeruju u laž, nego zulumćari niječu Allahove ajete“ – ar-Rāġib objašnjava: ne nalaze te lažovom i ne mogu dokazati tvoju laž; ono što čine, sam ajet naziva ǧuḥūd.
explanation.en: “… they deny not thee (Muhammad) but evil-doers flout the revelations of Allah” — ar-Rāġib explains: they do not find you a liar and cannot establish a lie against you; what they do, the ayah itself calls ǧuḥūd.

gloss.en: to belie, to call a lie

quranTranslation.text: And they denied them, though their souls acknowledged them, for spite and arrogance. Then see the nature of the consequence for the wrong-doers!

explanation.bs: „I zanijekali su ih, a duše su im u njih bile uvjerene, iz nepravde i oholosti“ – nijekanje uprkos znanju; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And they denied them, though their souls acknowledged them, for spite and arrogance” — denial against knowledge; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: But it is clear revelations in the hearts of those who have been given knowledge, and none deny Our revelations save wrong-doers.

explanation.bs: „… a Naše ajete niječu samo zulumćari“ – ajeti su jasni u prsima onih kojima je dato znanje.
explanation.en: “… none deny Our revelations save wrong-doers” — the revelations are clear in the hearts of those given knowledge.

quranTranslation.text: They know the favour of Allah and then deny it. Most of them are ingrates.

explanation.bs: „Oni poznaju Allahovu blagodat, a zatim je ne priznaju …“ – poznaju je, pa je ipak odriču; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “They know the favour of Allah and then deny it” — they know it, and yet disown it; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to disown, to refuse to acknowledge

quranTranslation.text: And He showeth you His tokens. Which, then, of the tokens of Allah do ye deny?

explanation.bs: „… pa koji to od Allahovih znakova ne priznajete?“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Which, then, of the tokens of Allah do ye deny?” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to disown, to refuse to acknowledge

quranTranslation.text: Make ready for them all thou canst of (armed) force and of horses tethered, that thereby ye may dismay the enemy of Allah and your enemy, and others beside them whom ye know not. Allah knoweth them. Whatsoever ye spend in the way of Allah it will be repaid to you in full, and ye will not be wronged.

explanation.bs: „I pripremite protiv njih koliko god možete snage i konja privezanih …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Make ready for them all thou canst of (armed) force and of horses tethered” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And vie one with another for forgiveness from your Lord, and for a paradise as wide as are the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who ward off (evil);

explanation.bs: „I požurite ka oprostu od vašeg Gospodara i Džennetu širokom kao nebesa i Zemlja, pripremljenom za bogobojazne“ – Džennet je spreman unaprijed, kako Njemu priliči.
explanation.en: “And vie one with another for forgiveness from your Lord, and for a paradise as wide as are the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who ward off (evil)” — the Garden is ready beforehand, as befits Him.

quranTranslation.text: When the young men fled for refuge to the Cave and said: Our Lord! Give us mercy from Thy presence, and shape for us right conduct in our plight.

explanation.bs: „… Gospodaru naš, daj nam milost od Sebe i uredi nam u našoj stvari pravi put“ – molitva mladića u pećini; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Our Lord! Give us mercy from Thy presence, and shape for us right conduct in our plight” — the prayer of the youths in the Cave; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And when ye withdraw from them and that which they worship except Allah, then seek refuge in the Cave; your Lord will spread for you of His mercy and will prepare for you a pillow in your plight.

explanation.bs: Mladići se nadaju da će im Gospodar raširiti Svoju milost i urediti im u njihovoj stvari ono što olakšava – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: The youths hope that their Lord will spread His mercy for them and set right for them, in their plight, what eases it — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.
